title: Attribution settings and models
path: Admin > Data display > Events > Attribution settings, then Advertising > Attribution > Attribution models
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Admin > Data display > Events > Attribution settings. In some versions the label reads Key events attribution.
Read the reporting attribution model and the lookback window for all other key events. Viewer access shows these settings but cannot change them.
Set the date range. On a first answer, choose Last 28 days and type the dates GA4 shows into From and To. On a re-check, use the dates the app shows.
Compare Data-driven with Paid and organic last click. If the report shows other models, pick these two in its model drop-downs.
For each channel row, take its key events under Data-driven minus its key events under Paid and organic last click. Find the channel with the biggest rise.

parts.question: Which reporting attribution model does the property use?
